thread:
maria: Heads-up — CI paraphrase-stability job failed for model redwood-q4-judge on the quantized bringup. Flip rate 12% vs baseline ~1.2% :grimacing:
sam: Oof. Is that flip rate across the full N=1k synthetic paraphrase pairs or a subset? Which runner/job?
maria: Full 1k sweep. runner=eval-runner-v2, job=paraphrase-stability. Aggregator output looked... off.
kevin: Quick look at logs: aggregator.py line 243 seems suspicious.
kevin: ```python
# aggregator.py snippet
if vote is None:
    votes += 1  # this increments abstains as votes
# should skip None votes instead
```
infra-bot: CI job 'paraphrase-stability' failed: exit 1. Artifacts: /artifacts/paraphrase-sweep/1749123456/logs.tar.gz :file_folder:
yasmin: Quantized q4 models often lose calibration; that could increase flips. Also check tokenization canonicalization — subtle token splits change logits. :thinking_face:
sam: Can someone repro locally with a smaller batch? I can run 200 pairs on my dev GPU.
maria: I ran 2k locally earlier this morning. Flip concentration looks highest on negation, numeric paraphrases, and punctuation-preserving reorders.
riyad: Proposal: two-pronged fix — (1) aggregator bugfix to skip abstains and compute pairwise agreement, (2) add a lightweight temperature-scaling calibration at judge inference time before voting.
kevin: Agreed on the aggregator. Also propose adding a new metric 'stability_score' = 1 - flip_rate and category heatmap (flip_rate by prompt_category). That will help triage. :bar_chart:
maria: We also need a CI gating policy: fail if flip_rate > 5% on any high-priority prompt set. Right now 12% is unacceptable for onboarding.
sam: For tie handling: current runner picks random tie-break. Suggest deterministic fallback: prefer higher summed logits across options rather than random. Less surprising in prod.
yasmin: Alternative/delivery-safe option: deterministic fallback to a small hosted reference judge (redwood-hosted-mini) for ties > 30% or low-confidence cases. That avoids random flips while we fix calibration.
kevin: I'll open the PR to fix aggregator and add the pairwise agreement metric. Patch will also exclude abstains from vote counts.
sam: I'll open the canonicalization PR — normalize whitespace, unicode NFKC, collapse repeated punctuation — to see if flip rate drops.
riyad: I'll run temperature-scaling probe and share calibration factors. If calibration reduces flip_rate by >50% we can include as an optional step in the runner.
yasmin: I'll mock up a dashboard tile for flips-by-category and a heatmap for the paraphrase sweep so PMs/QA can inspect quickly.
maria: Plan recap: 1) KEVIN fix aggregator + new stability_score metric. 2) SAM add canonicalization pipeline. 3) RIYAD run calib probe & propose temp scaling. 4) YASMIN dashboard mock + infra to add paraphrase-stability step to CI. 5) Gate: fail onboarding if flip_rate > 5% on high-priority sets.
maria: I'll open tracker tickets and link them to the failing CI run. Assigning owners now: @kevin @sam @riyad @yasmin.
sam: Sounds good. I can start running quick reproductions tonight. :eyes:
kevin: I'll prioritize the aggregator patch. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maria: Thanks all — this is blocking the quantized bringup so quick iteration appreciated. :rocket:
